tasks.title: Independently review and merge the structural closure planning package
acceptance: Verify exact source-document digests and have an independent reviewer challenge GAP, ownership, dependency and anti-layering decisions.
Merge the reviewed planning package through PR with required checks and exact merge evidence; do not change product runtime.
tasks.rollback: Revert the documentation-only merge if review discovers a material planning defect.

tasks.title: Materialize and enforce product ownership inventories
acceptance: Map every mutable aggregate and mounted mutation route to exactly one command owner, store owner and readback projection.
Classify all audited duplicate definitions, dead tails and worker subjects; reject missing or multiple authorities.
tasks.rollback: Revert enforcement while retaining the reviewed inventory as evidence.

tasks.title: Design staging and production closure without provisioning
acceptance: Re-verify current staging and production unavailability and produce SA/SD, authority, threat, resource/cost, exact-pair promotion and rollback designs.
Keep staging ephemeral and production control/execution isolated; create no resource, credential, ingress, production-data or live-capital side effect.
Materialize any proposed implementation as separately privileged future packets that remain undispatched pending explicit authorized-operator/MFA authorization.
tasks.rollback: Documentation-only task; revert its reviewed planning PR if the environment baseline changes.

tasks.title: Normalize BFF package imports and remove dynamic namespace wiring
acceptance: All recorded BFF entrypoints use one stable import root.
Production domain/router sys.path mutation and globals-based namespace forwarding are zero; no parallel package tree remains.
tasks.rollback: Revert exact import migration commit; do not preserve both package layouts.

tasks.title: Make the operator BFF an explicit composition root
acceptance: Inject typed domain query, command and event dependencies and make required command-owner absence fail startup closed.
Composition and mounted-route tests finish within budget; no production service imports main.
mandatory_deletion: global read_store service locator and callers
Deployment service reverse import from main
copied domain behavior remaining in main for migrated scopes
tasks.rollback: Revert the exact wave; never keep old and new dependency assembly active together.

tasks.title: Delete confirmed unreachable BFF code tails
acceptance: Control-flow scan reports no audited statement after an unconditional terminal branch.
Deprecated public routes retain only their intended minimal response and tests no longer exercise dead bodies.
tasks.rollback: Revert only if a documented production caller was missed; do not restore uncallable tails as fallback.

tasks.title: Decouple BFF tests from composition globals
acceptance: Classify and migrate the audited 218 main-importing tests to composition, router, application, adapter or hosted layers.
Only a reviewed composition allowlist imports the app; focused files collect and complete within explicit timeout budgets.
mandatory_deletion: test sys.path surgery made obsolete by package normalization
tasks.rollback: Revert fixture migration per domain without restoring product globals.

tasks.title: Split giant BFF router closures by cohesive use case
acceptance: Parent routers only include cohesive resource/use-case subrouters and preserve normalized route contracts.
Business branching and transactions move to application owners; changed factories meet the review guardrail or document a cohesion exception.
mandatory_deletion: router-owned business/store logic in migrated scopes
tasks.rollback: Revert complete resource slices, not individual forwarding shims.

tasks.title: Bind every product mutation to one canonical domain owner
acceptance: Replace every audited missing ReadSurfacePorts mutation with a typed owner command and canonical receipt.
Idempotency, optimistic conflict, tenant isolation, outbox and fresh owner readback pass for every mounted mutation route.
mandatory_deletion: BFF-local mutation fallbacks for migrated aggregates
tasks.rollback: Use exact prior release/store-compatible schema; never fall back to process memory.

tasks.title: Converge Decision Journal to one durable implementation
acceptance: Select the owner using the reviewed transaction, audit, isolation, outbox and consumer scorecard.
Migrate identities and prove parity/restart/single-write behavior with zero old callers or table writes.
mandatory_deletion: unselected Decision Journal implementation and bootstrap
tasks.rollback: Roll back the exact release before old-writer deletion; no permanent dual write.

tasks.title: Retire process-local product state overlays
acceptance: Backfill and shadow-compare Persona, Strategy, Incident, Job and Ranking owner projections with conflict reports.
Restart and multi-replica readback pass with one canonical writer and no fallback acknowledgement.
tasks.rollback: Deploy the exact prior compatible release; never re-enable dual writes.

tasks.title: Complete the natural Agora owner and receipt chain
acceptance: Connect workshop request/outbox/worker, authentic research receipt, dataset/candidate, decision, one learning handoff and telemetry-triggered suggestion with one correlation chain.
Retry, DLQ, SSE cursor, restart and server-side provenance tests pass without a new scheduler.
tasks.rollback: Disable new consumers and deploy the prior exact paper-safe release without deleting canonical receipts.

tasks.title: Build durable receipt-derived twelve-loop truth
acceptance: Persist release/correlation/loop observations from canonical stimulus, terminal and next-consumer receipts.
Incremental equals rebuild; backfill cannot replace newer live truth; registry maturity never sets runtime completion.
tasks.rollback: Disable the new read projection while preserving source receipts.

acceptance: Management rows expose owner, source, version, freshness and degradation without silently omitting unavailable owners.
Management AI remains product-only and provider failure is independent from ordinary reads; confirmed commands are typed and paper-safe.

acceptance: Production bundle uses live/strict/safe-write defaults and contains no reachable fixture, seed, mock transport, local write overlay or embedded bearer token.
Management and Agora render honest unavailable/degraded states and the task delivers through execute-plans dev PR/check/review/merge.
tasks.rollback: Restore the prior accepted frontend artifact, not a rebuilt mutable branch.

Validate hosted manifest HTTP/content/schema before JSON parsing and produce a checksum-bound baseline only from accepted identities; workflow tests cover empty, HTML, invalid and drift cases.

Restart BFF/workers, reconnect SSE from cursor and prove durable idempotent readback with honest degraded states.

tasks.title: Retire remaining structural compatibility and copied bodies
acceptance: Delete satisfied compatibility adapters, classified duplicate bodies, stale facade tests/references and superseded delivery paths after hosted proof.
All ownership, import, route, state, test-runtime and anti-layering gates pass with independently reviewed closeout evidence.
